title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Claude Bruderlein is Adjunct Lecturer on Global Health at the Harvard T. Chan School of Public Healthand and Senior Researcher at the Harvard Humanitarian Initiative. He also holds a secondary appointment at the Harvard Kennedy School of Government, where he teaches strategic planning and frontline negotiation. In his research, Mr. Bruderlein focuses particularly on the conduct of negotiation in complex and hostile environments.
research_interests: Human Rights Decision Making & Negotiation International Relations & Security
